newsitem.title: UK: BSkyB jumps as buyers catch market short.
newsitem.headline: BSkyB jumps as buyers catch market short.

text.p: Shares in British Sky Broadcasting Plc jumped on Tuesday as a burst of buying after yesterday's decline caught the market short of stock, dealers said.

The stock was up 21p at 585 by 1030 GMT. On Monday the stock closed 2p lower following reports that Time Warner planned an offensive against satellite broadcasters in the U.S. with an interactive TV system.
"It was dull yesterday and we have seen some speculative buying today, but I have not heard any specific stories on the stock," said one market-maker.
Added another dealer: "There were some short positions and the buyers came in which squeezed the price higher."
Last week BSkyB shares rose after analysts at Dresdner Kleinwort Benson repeated a "buy" rating.
